entries.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: transparent full-body key art for the THE PIT character selector in the user's 2D Yautja game. Input image 1 is the user's existing OpenAI presentation plate of Jungle Hunter and is the main style and character reference. Derive a refined fighting-ready variant of THIS presentation, retaining its intricate crisp pixel-art texture, muted palette, tall lean muscular proportions, black dreadlocks and sparse 1987 armor layout. Preserve the yellow-olive mottled skin, black diamond net, bone trophies, loincloth, one shoulder plasma caster and paired wrist blades. Correct the helmet toward the original Predator (1987) Jungle Hunter film mask: broad smooth brushed silver dome flowing into the brow, recessed narrow dark eye slits, angular cheek and chin plates; remove the exaggerated separate raised oval medallion shape of the reference crown. No mouth or teeth visible through the mask. Pose: balanced alert dueling guard, knees subtly bent, facing screen-right in three-quarter lateral view, wrist blades visible completely, free hand raised slightly; preserve anatomical equipment anchors, no mirroring. One entire body with all dreadlocks, cannon, blades, hands and both feet inside frame, portrait 2:3, ideally 1024x1536, 8% safe margins. Character occupies about 82% of canvas height, no cropped weapon. Actual transparent RGBA background, not a checkerboard image, not black, not chroma. Neutral material lighting, no floor or contact shadow. Same original game-pixel-art medium as input, no photography or toy joints, no text, UI, logo, watermark, border, extra characters, alternate heads or detached props. This is a single original project illustration, not an animation sheet. Do not add smart disc, spear, modern breastplate or invented weapons.
Reference routing: the last four inline image previews are Jungle Hunter, City Hunter, Berserker and Wolf respectively. Use ONLY Image 1 (Jungle Hunter) as the target; the others are unrelated and must not be blended into the result. These inline previews are supplied because direct local image reads fail in this environment.

entries.handCorrectionPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct BOTH HANDS AND THEIR COMBISTICK GRIP in this City Hunter pixel-art character image; the user identified malformed hand anatomy. Keep all other pixels and design as unchanged as possible: same 1990 City Hunter mask, body, orange spotted skin, armor, black net, stance, full body, spear diagonal direction and dimensions, equipment, dark #101916 background, pixel-art density and 1024x1536 format. The hand at screen-right near the waist must be a clearly readable anatomical closed grip around the spear shaft: four distinct curled fingers wrapping the front side, one opposable thumb locking from the opposite side, palm and knuckles continuous with the wrist gauntlet. The shaft must pass inside the grip, never through fingers or flesh. The supporting hand at screen-left near chest height must likewise show a proper grasp with four curled fingers plus one thumb, matching its forearm orientation. The long combistick must stay perfectly straight and continuous through both grips. No additional hand, no extra arm, no extra weapon, no cropping, no changed mask, no text. Make the local hand silhouettes unambiguous at small game selection size. Do not just add details over the malformed grip; redraw its anatomy correctly.
